scope: Independent Node service behavior, mocked chain transport failure handling, and Rust/client source inspection. No actual Solana runtime execution in this report.

checks.detail: src/App.tsx:70 uses Array.findLast under ES2022 and produces an implicit-any callback diagnostic. UI owner/controller informed; outside tester write scope.

independentFindings.issue: Payment intent only held in memory while external effect ran, permitting silent resubmission after restart
independentFindings.regression: in-flight chain effect is durable before an outbound payment can complete
independentFindings.resolution: Controller persisted pending state before invoking effect; independent rerun passes

independentFindings.issue: Reset retries discarded idempotency and created multiple replacement scenario identities
independentFindings.regression: retrying reset preserves the first replacement scenario identity across restart
independentFindings.resolution: Controller persisted reset identity and archived previous state; independent rerun passes

independentFindings.issue: Confirmed transaction followed by failed account refresh lost known signature in thrown error
independentFindings.regression: post-confirmation account refresh failure retains the known transaction identity
independentFindings.resolution: SDE added refresh error wrapper retaining signature/confirmation/evidence; independent rerun passes

independentFindings.issue: Byte-identical stale instruction proof needed explicit check after transaction deserialization
independentFindings.resolution: SDE added serialized byte equality check before broadcast; source verified

coveredServiceBehaviors: one persona cannot satisfy both approval slots
wrong persona cannot approve or revise credit
credit invalidates old approvals and stale requests cannot mutate state
same credit retry and conflicting idempotency key across restart
execute-first paid state survives replay and credit attempt
eight concurrent payment requests yield one settlement evidence item
rehearsal has no fabricated blockchain signatures
invalid values, actors and action inputs reject without financial mutation
durable pending operation and unknown outcome block fresh payment after restart
old authorization rehearsal attempt moves no local balance
signed transaction persisted before mocked RPC send
submission and post-confirmation RPC failures preserve transaction identity
limitations: Client transport tests replace RPC methods and cannot validate the Rust program, network confirmation, token accounting or CPI rollback.
Compiled SBF negative transactions, token-program rollback, deployed binary/source provenance and live devnet proof remain parent/SDE-owned outstanding gates at report time.
Real service-to-chain adapter reconciliation and HTTP end-to-end integration were not available during this bounded review and require follow-up.
No browser/accountant evaluation was performed by this source-aware tester; that role must have a separate fresh context.

Program execution is intentionally permissionless once configured distinct approvers authorize exact immutable settlement terms; API executor persona is a demonstration control, not an on-chain allowlist.
